en.name: Mullet roe
en.summary: Mullet roe is the whole egg sac salted, pressed and sun-dried into an amber slab — 烏魚子, karasumi, bottarga. It is not shelf-stable: Taiwan's agriculture ministry states plainly that the finished roe must be kept frozen or refrigerated. Frozen it runs 3–4 months, after which the fat oxidises and the colour dulls.
en.pantry: This is the part people get wrong: a slab of mullet roe looks like a preserve and is not one. The cure takes only about a tenth to a sixth of the roe's weight in salt and a few days of sun-drying, which is nowhere near enough to make it stable at room temperature. Bring it out only to bring it up to temperature before grilling, and put the rest back cold. A vacuum-packed gift box left in a warm cupboard until Chinese New Year is exactly the wrong thing to do with it.
en.fridge: Keep it vacuum-packed or tightly wrapped at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and cut only what you will grill. No day count is given here because the source that requires chilling or freezing does not distinguish the two, and inventing a fridge figure would be worse than leaving the rule to stand: chilled or frozen, and go by how it looks and smells. Once a vacuum pack is cut, rewrap the remainder tightly against the cut face — the exposed surface dries, darkens and goes rancid before the rest does.
en.freezer: The freezer is where a good slab belongs: 3–4 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Beyond about 4 months the fat oxidises and the roe turns from amber to a dull dark red — that colour change is the practical end of its life, and it happens before anything unsafe does. Double-wrap it, or keep it in its vacuum pack inside a bag, and let it thaw in the fridge rather than on the counter so condensation does not settle on the surface.
en.thawing: Thaw it in the fridge, still wrapped, then bring it to room temperature briefly before peeling the membrane and grilling. Do not thaw it in water and do not refreeze a slab you have cut into.
spoilage: Colour gone from amber to dull dark red or brown.
A rancid, paint-like smell instead of a rich salty-marine one.
A sticky or weeping surface under the membrane.
Any mould, or a bitter taste when grilled.
tips: Keep it in the freezer, not in a gift cupboard.
Cut only what you will grill and rewrap the rest tightly.
Judge it by colour: amber is good, dull dark red is finished.
Thaw in the fridge to avoid condensation on the surface.

faq.q: Does mullet roe need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Yes. Finished mullet roe must be kept refrigerated or frozen — the salting and sun-drying are not enough to make it shelf-stable.

faq.q: How long can you freeze mullet roe?
faq.a: 3–4 months at −18 °C. Past about 4 months the fat oxidises and the colour turns from amber to dull dark red.

faq.q: How long does it keep in the fridge?
faq.a: No published figure separates fridge from freezer, so no day count is given. Keep it cold, wrapped, and judge it by colour and smell.

faq.q: How can you tell if mullet roe has gone off?
faq.a: The amber colour dulls to dark red, and the smell turns rancid rather than rich and salty. Mould or a sticky surface means it goes.

zh.name: 烏魚子
zh.summary: 烏魚子是整副卵巢經鹽漬、壓製、日曬後形成的琥珀色薄板。它並不是常溫保存品：農業部明確指出成品應予冷凍或冷藏。冷凍大約可放 3～4 個月，之後脂肪氧化、顏色轉暗。
zh.pantry: 這正是最多人搞錯的地方：一片烏魚子看起來像保存食品，其實不是。鹽的用量大約只佔卵重的十分之一到六分之一，日曬也只有幾天，遠遠不足以讓它在室溫穩定。只有要烤之前才拿出來回溫，其餘立刻冰回去。把真空包裝的禮盒放在溫暖的櫥櫃裡等過年再吃，正是最不該做的事。
zh.fridge: 真空包裝或包緊後放 4 °C 以下，要烤多少切多少。這裡不給天數，因為要求「冷藏或冷凍」的來源並沒有區分兩者，而自己編一個冷藏數字，比讓規則原樣成立更糟：就是要冷藏或冷凍，然後靠外觀和氣味判斷。真空包一旦切開，剩下的要緊貼切面重新包好——暴露的切面會比其他部分更早變乾、變暗、走油耗。
zh.freezer: 冷凍庫才是好烏魚子該待的地方：−18 °C 下 3～4 個月。超過大約 4 個月，脂肪氧化，顏色會從琥珀色轉為暗紅——那個顏色變化就是它實務上的終點，而且發生在任何安全問題之前。請包兩層，或連真空包一起裝進袋子，解凍時放冷藏而不是放室溫，避免水氣凝在表面。
zh.thawing: 連包裝放冷藏解凍，之後短暫回到室溫，再撕掉外膜燒烤。不要泡水解凍；已經切開的也不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 顏色由琥珀轉為暗紅或褐色。
聞起來有油耗、油漆般的氣味，而不是濃郁的鹹鮮香。
外膜底下的表面發黏或滲出液體。
長霉，或烤過後吃起來發苦。
tips: 放冷凍庫，不要放禮盒櫃。
要烤多少切多少，其餘緊貼切面包好。
用顏色判斷：琥珀色是好的，暗紅就是到頭了。
放冷藏解凍，避免表面結露。

faq.a: 需要。成品烏魚子必須冷藏或冷凍——鹽漬和日曬的程度不足以讓它常溫穩定。
−18 °C 下 3～4 個月。超過大約 4 個月，脂肪氧化，顏色會由琥珀轉為暗紅。

faq.q: 烏魚子冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 沒有任何公告數字把冷藏和冷凍分開，所以這裡不給天數。保持低溫、包好，並以顏色和氣味判斷。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷烏魚子壞掉了？
faq.a: 琥珀色轉暗紅、氣味從濃郁鹹香變成油耗味。長霉或表面發黏就要丟掉。
